question:
Consider a modified Bernoulli equation.

$$\left(P + \frac{A}{Bt^2}\right) + \rho g(h + Bt) + \frac{1}{2}\rho V^2 = \text{constant}$$

If $t$ has the dimension of time then the dimensions of $A$ and $B$ are _____, _____ respectively.
solution:
Only quantities with the same dimensions can be added, so every term inside a bracket must match the other term in that bracket.

**Finding $B$:** $Bt$ is added to the height $h$, so $[Bt] = [\mathrm{L}]$:
$$[B] = \frac{[\mathrm{L}]}{[\mathrm{T}]} = [\mathrm{M^0LT^{-1}}]$$

**Finding $A$:** $\dfrac{A}{Bt^2}$ is added to the pressure $P$, so
$$\left[\frac{A}{Bt^2}\right] = [P] = [\mathrm{ML^{-1}T^{-2}}]$$
$$[A] = [\mathrm{ML^{-1}T^{-2}}]\,[B]\,[t^2] = [\mathrm{ML^{-1}T^{-2}}][\mathrm{LT^{-1}}][\mathrm{T^2}] = [\mathrm{ML^0T^{-1}}]$$

So $A = [\mathrm{ML^0T^{-1}}]$ and $B = [\mathrm{M^0LT^{-1}}]$, which is option (D).
